mapper.select: SELECT GROUP_CODE, METRIC, LOW_LIMIT, HIGH_LIMIT, SEVERITY, ENABLED FROM ALERT_RULE
SELECT CARD_CODE, JOB_KIND FROM POS_PERSON WHERE JOB_KIND IS NOT NULL

SELECT ID, CARD_CODE, DEVICE_IMEI, CODE, OCCURRED_AT, LAST_OCCURRED_AT FROM (SELECT e.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY NVL(CARD_CODE, 'imei:' || DEVICE_IMEI), CODE ORDER BY LAST_OCCURRED_AT DESC, ID DESC) RN FROM ALERT_EVENT e WHERE OCCURRED_AT >= #{dayStart} AND LAST_OCCURRED_AT >= #{since}) WHERE RN = 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ALERT_EVENT (CARD_CODE, SRC, CODE, CATEGORY, SEVERITY, VAL_TEXT, RULE_GROUP, OCCURRED_AT, LAST_OCCURRED_AT, OCCUR_COUNT, DEVICE_IMEI) VALUES (#{cardCode}, #{src}, #{code}, #{category}, #{severity}, #{valText}, #{ruleGroup}, #{occurredAt}, #{occurredAt}, 1, #{deviceImei})
mapper.update: UPDATE ALERT_EVENT SET LAST_OCCURRED_AT = GREATEST(LAST_OCCURRED_AT, #{at}), OCCUR_COUNT = OCCUR_COUNT + 1 WHERE ID = #{id}
